name: Broken Toys
source:
Since the Toy Maker's Garden fell to darkness, the living dolls there have struggled to stay alive, but still find love.

Greggory, one of the few sentient dolls known as Cherubs to remember their name after centuries of darkness is on a simple quest to keep the lights on in his village in order to keep the all-consuming darkness away. Along the way he meets others of his kind, other sentient dolls and the best way they know how to fight the darkness is with love, and he can make plenty of love to all of them.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/broken-toys]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从Toy Maker's Garden陷入黑暗，那里活着的人偶便一直努力求生，却依然没有放弃寻找爱情。

Greggory是少数有自我意识、被称为Cherubs的人偶之一。历经数百年黑暗，他仍记得自己的名字，如今只想让村里的灯火继续亮着，抵御吞噬一切的黑暗。途中，他遇见了其他同类——有自我意识的人偶。他们知道，对抗黑暗的最好办法就是爱；而Greggory可以尽情与大家相爱。

[来源：[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/broken-toys]Itch.io[/url]]
